verdict.rationale: Docs mention an `auto` mode that chains across three models and two providers, automatically switching if one is having 'a bad day' (byteask-docs-29), which shows some automatic model routing rather than developer-picked models. However this reads more as failover/resilience across providers than true per-task 'best model' selection based on task complexity or cost, and there's no detail on selection criteria or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit task-aware model selection logic, pricing/cost-optimization framing tied to this feature, and independent confirmation it works as described.
